definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to name a specific match, contest, or campaign. Common in sports, board-game titles, military history, and political races.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{決勝|けっしょう}{戦|せん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧{戦|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The shogi Meijin championship has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{戦|せん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予想以上|よそういじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: This election campaign looks like it will be more intense than expected.

notes:
Suffix forming compound nouns for individual matches, tournaments, or campaigns. Highly productive across sports, games, and politics. The base noun usually names the type or stage of the contest.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}{戦|せん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧: final match
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}{戦|せん}: semifinal
- ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧{戦|せん}: Meijin tournament (shogi/go title match)
- ⟦{対|たい}{戦|せん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧: head-to-head match
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{戦|せん}: election campaign
- ⟦{延長|えんちょう}{戦|せん}→延長戦：06540_enchousen⟧: extra innings; overtime
- {持久|じきゅう}{戦|せん}: war of attrition; endurance contest
- ⟦{接|せっ}{戦|せん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧: close match

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧: match — the stand-alone noun for a single sports match
- 〜⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧: cup (suffix) — names a trophy or tournament series (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧)
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: tournament — refers to the whole event, not a single match
